answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. For every name, a deposit of 83 credits, frozen until 10 days after the grading closes leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. One falcon, one entry.
